name: Nevalyashka
summary: Nevalyashka is a Mean Reversion EA that trades price deviations from a moving average centerline. It opens positions when price moves excessively away from the mean and closes when price reverts back. The strategy relies on statistical return-to-mean behavior with fixed lot sizing and stop loss protection.
summary_zh: Nevalyashka是一个均值回归EA，基于价格偏离均线中心线的程度进行交易。当价格过度偏离均值时开仓，价格回归时平仓。该策略依赖统计回归均值行为，采用固定手数和止损保护。
strategy_analysis: Nevalyashka策略的核心概念是均值回归，即价格偏离移动平均线达到一定程度后倾向于回归。入场条件为价格偏离均线超过设定的阈值倍数时开仓，做多当价格向下偏离，做空当价格向上偏离。出场条件包括价格回归到均线附近时获利平仓，以及触及止损时亏损平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面设有止损和止盈，但缺乏复合仓位管理或加仓机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但在趋势行情中可能面临连续亏损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Nevalyashka strategy is mean reversion, expecting price to return to its moving average after significant deviations. Entry conditions trigger when price deviates beyond a configured threshold multiplier from the moving average line — longs when price is below the mean, shorts when above. Exit conditions include profit-taking when price reverts to the moving average vicinity, and stop-loss execution when the deviation continues against the position. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management incorporates stop loss and take profit levels, but lacks compounding position management or scaling-in mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, but it faces the risk of consecutive losses during strong trending markets where mean reversion fails.

parameters.name: DeviationMultiplier
parameters.description_en: Deviation multiplier threshold from moving average

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Unique EA order identifier preventing conflicts

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
设有止损保护，避免单笔亏损过大
均值回归在震荡行情中表现良好
参数较少，优化空间明确
回测和实盘行为一致性较高
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Stop loss protection prevents excessive single-trade losses
Mean reversion performs well in ranging markets
High consistency between backtesting and live trading behavior
cons: 趋势行情中容易连续止损
固定手数不适应不同账户规模
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡和趋势市
无加仓或减仓机制，灵活性不足
偏离阈值静态设定，未考虑波动率变化
cons_en: Prone to consecutive stop losses during trending markets
Fixed lot size doesn't adapt to different account sizes
Lacks a trend filter to distinguish ranging from trending markets
No position scaling mechanism, limited flexibility
Static deviation threshold doesn't account for volatility changes
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如ADX），在趋势行情中暂停交易
将固定手数改为基于ATR或账户余额的动态仓位管理
使用ATR动态调整偏离阈值，适应不同波动环境
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX) to pause trading during strong trends
Replace fixed lot size with dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account equity
Use ATR to dynamically adjust deviation thresholds for different volatility regimes

risk_points: 趋势行情中可能连续触发止损导致资金回撤
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过大高波动时过小
无最大回撤限制或账户权益保护机制
risk_points_en: Consecutive stop losses during trending markets can cause significant drawdown
Fixed stop loss doesn't adapt to market volatility — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high
No maximum drawdown limit or account equity protection mechanism

The strategy relies on statistical return-to-mean behavior with fixed lot sizing and stop loss protection.
